Passing Complaint Period(only for negotiation and negotiation.quick)

For activate complaint period, you need to update cancellation from draft to pending.

Before activating cancellation request, you must add a signature file to cancellation. If there is no signature file when activating the cancellation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/7443f2bcc1da4f3ab5400ac8216c5692/cancellations/8fdaed08e00c49468fa9bf713248ee91?acc_token=955ba98fce244b3aa2cd16bcdbd01e2a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",

When cancellation in pending status the tender owner is prohibited from all actions on the tender.

Activating the request and cancelling tender

if the complaint period(duration 10 days) is over and there were no complaints or all complaints are canceled, then cancellation will automatically update status to active.

Before activating tender it is required to add sign document to tender. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: notice and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/documents?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/5cc9e5107bdd435bae2a71979d095dd1?Signature=WTDNnNgW8deqUx%2BKsR1LTob35PBm38l5cHcRuHFqQAkJukkvR9yUOUU995gGXqwx0dlRv2Z36gExSJiNdZ4ZBg%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/documents/5180d356b28548eaa0c1881768d608b5

Expand
{
  "data": {
    "confidentiality": "public",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/5cc9e5107bdd435bae2a71979d095dd1?Signature=zw7oPBOVuWHvOqvOgV%2ByjEC03rcuNlT4XyrNuKqQhDtRJgtnYkGDWiKYk%2BTSOScx9UfXHQAJWpeeWcHvSbM2AA%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK

Procuring entity can not change tender if there are less than 7 days before tenderPeriod ends. Changes will not be accepted by API.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "value": {
      "amount": 501.0
    }
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "data",
      "description": "tenderPeriod should be extended by 4 days"
    }
  ]
}

That is why tenderPeriod has to be extended by 7 days.

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Then bidder should approve bid with pending status. If tenderers.identifier.scheme = ‘UA-EDR’ it is required to add sign document to bid. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/bids/26bd5b9cfa8f49f8b655b790775944ec?acc_token=d838be06648343148752cdb7c643774f HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'proposal' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: proposal and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "Proposal.p7s",

We can update tender during active.tendering period. Bids will be invalid after updating tender. For example, let’s reduce the lot price to 400.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/lots/529f0da7929f4dbbb94b70eb6f8d2771?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "value": {
      "currency": "UAH",
      "amount": 400,
      "valueAddedTaxIncluded": true
    }
  }
}

Confirming qualification

Qualification comission can set award to active or unsuccessful status.

There are validations before registering qualification decision:

eligible: True and qualified: True - for setting award from pending to active

eligible: False and qualified: True OR eligible: True and qualified: False OR eligible: False and qualified: False - for setting award from pending to unsuccessful

Let’s try to set unsuccessful status for qualified and eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/awards/365de78bba1341989d83627a367a376c?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "unsuccessful",
    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Let’s try to set active status for non-qualified or non-eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/awards/365de78bba1341989d83627a367a376c?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity

  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to active status with not qualified"

}

Setting Contract

In EContracting the contract is created directly in contracting system.

Note

Some of data will be mirrored to tender until contract will be activated for backward compatibility.

Read more about working with EContracting in contracting system in Tutorial section.

Cancelling tender

Tender creator can cancel tender anytime (except when tender in status active.auction or in terminal status e.g. unsuccessful, canceled, complete).

The following steps should be applied:

Prepare cancellation request.

Fill it with the protocol describing the cancellation reasons.

Passing complaint period(4 days)

Cancel the tender with the prepared reasons.

Only the request that has been activated (4th step above) has power to cancel tender. I.e. you have to not only prepare cancellation request but to activate it as well.

For cancelled cancellation you need to update cancellation status to unsuccessful from draft or pending.

See Cancellation data structure for details.

Preparing the cancellation request

You should pass reason and reasonType, status defaults to draft.

There are four possible types of cancellation reason - tender was noDemand, unFixable, forceMajeure and expensesCut.

id is autogenerated and passed in the Location header of response.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/cancellations?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "reasonType": "unFixable"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/cancellations/e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0

{
  "data": {
    "reasonType": "unFixable",
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "id": "e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0",
    "date": "2027-01-01T00:06:00+02:00",
    "cancellationOf": "tender",
    "status": "draft"
  }
}

You can change reasonType value to any of the above.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/cancellations/e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "reasonType": "forceMajeure"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "data": {
    "id": "e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0",
    "status": "draft",
    "date": "2027-01-01T00:06:00+02:00",
    "reasonType": "forceMajeure",
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "cancellationOf": "tender"
  }
}

Passing Complaint Period

For activate complaint period, you need to update cancellation from draft to pending.

Before activating cancellation request, you must add a signature file to cancellation. If there is no signature file when activating the cancellation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/cancellations/e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'cancellationReport' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: cancellationReport and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/896f80313bfc43d2aa3f0f44fc56a513/cancellations/e2f602d1d8bb4d56afbe3b05eb613ac0/documents?acc_token=f63fd82030a24dfc961d6995dc3f33d1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "documentType": "cancellationReport",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/0cc93e50d3dc42319e5a6ca35d12495b?Signature=jGs7j8XulXYA605i8H4G%2BkBSiDSCYkv4EfwfhHyrMgH0IS6qCG2ARx3omgiP3Bjf5RvoqEgnTg5njX%2FZkI20BQ%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature"
  }

When cancellation in pending status the tender owner is prohibited from all actions on the tender.

Activating the request and cancelling tender

if the complaint period(duration 4 days) is over and there were no complaints or all complaints are canceled, then cancellation will automatically update status to active.

Now we can see that new object was created. Response code is 201 and Location response header reports the location of the created object. The body of response reveals the information about the created tender: its internal id (that matches the Location segment), its official tenderID and dateModified datestamp stating the moment in time when tender was last modified. Note that tender is created with active.tendering status.

The peculiarity of the Open EU procedure is that procurementMethodType was changed from belowThreshold to aboveThresholdEU. Also there is no opportunity to set up enquiryPeriod, it will be assigned automatically.

Tender can contain several different lots. We can add lot using the following way:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/5429c1a3494f4034839597408f6cde96/lots?acc_token=0a7bc93b7888415684a0ce45d6271f2d HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Authorization: Bearer broker

Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Procuring entity approves qualifications by switching to next status.

Before approving qualifications it is required to add sign document to tender. Sign doc should be added generally for tender if there is no lots. If there is no sign document during approving qualification, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/5429c1a3494f4034839597408f6cde96?acc_token=0a7bc93b7888415684a0ce45d6271f2d HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.pre-qualification.stand-still"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'evaluationReports' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Creating tender

POST /api/2.5/tenders?opt_pretty=1 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

We don’t see internal id of tender, because tender appears in the listing from active.tendering status.

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Before activating tender it is required to add sign document to tender. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: notice and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/documents?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/9d3bcd238312405b86678f243075c59d?Signature=1UjRUuMFsMVQ3Wkmmd5mC287CySJ68o6h83PzisO0cVE%2BEvzApDf5TfJy%2FKOeD07onfvhIjPhDAY8uS1l6D9Ag%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/documents/a3b60926cefd48a5a2b62b87bdbd6f6a

Expand
{
  "data": {
    "confidentiality": "public",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "title": "sign.p7s",

    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/9d3bcd238312405b86678f243075c59d?Signature=2dEne%2FE3tHtLMTb8kl9F7YgVGKshF66VMCz6qPWkgpOInfdeZI%2Bh5iymh8VQZA%2FGGnc%2FAqKxUNw057ZooVRJCg%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",

After adding needed criteria and sign document we can activate our tender, so let’s do that:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

We see the added properies have merged with existing tender data. Additionally, the dateModified property was updated to reflect the last modification datestamp.

Checking the listing again reflects the new modification date:

Procuring entity can not change tender if there are less than 7 days before tenderPeriod ends. Changes will not be accepted by API.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "value": {
      "amount": 501.0
    }
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "data",
      "description": "tenderPeriod should be extended by 7 days"
    }
  ]
}

That is why tenderPeriod has to be extended by 7 days.

Enquiries

POST /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/questions HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

To define the document as “private” - confidentiality and confidentialityRationale fields should be set.

confidentiality field value can be either buyerOnly (document is private) or public (document is publicly accessible).

Content of private documents (buyerOnly) can be accessed only by procuring entity or by participant who uploaded them.

confidentialityRationale field is required only for private documents and should contain at least 30 characters.

Let’s mark the document as “private”:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/bids/ba20f70bc7a74738820a155064861ddd/documents/b0952ea2ccbc4730a8f98c63bf63cb26?acc_token=f8eab56638a1495ca86515d62517236e HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "confidentiality": "buyerOnly",
    "confidentialityRationale": "Only our company sells badgers with pink hair."
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "data": {

Bid invalidation

GET /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/bids/ba20f70bc7a74738820a155064861ddd?acc_token=f8eab56638a1495ca86515d62517236e HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

Procuring entity approves qualifications by switching to next status.

Before approving qualifications it is required to add sign document to tender. Sign doc should be added generally for tender if there is no lots. If there is no sign document during approving qualification, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.pre-qualification.stand-still"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'evaluationReports' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: evaluationReports and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/documents?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "documentType": "evaluationReports",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/3616237eefb341cfae60864722c47a80?Signature=BEGEHEzahNTu4rV3sgdlk0CorREnwZr9hDxzCNvNVGLyBRpw9IpwpGwjPJ%2B6MBl4uUaXl9H4FVKljxCwJza7AA%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/documents/7d75bffde6b5435cb78f18851720a36a

Expand

Confirming qualification

Qualification comission can set award to active or unsuccessful status.

There are validations before registering qualification decision:

eligible: True and qualified: True - for setting award from pending to active

eligible: False and qualified: True OR eligible: True and qualified: False OR eligible: False and qualified: False - for setting award from pending to unsuccessful

Let’s try to set unsuccessful status for qualified and eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/awards/acb0accb91d54a75bdd3b04c6b06c1bb?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "unsuccessful",
    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Let’s try to set active status for non-qualified or non-eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/awards/acb0accb91d54a75bdd3b04c6b06c1bb?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active",
    "qualified": false,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to active status with not qualified"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Before making decision it is required to add sign document to award. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/awards/acb0accb91d54a75bdd3b04c6b06c1bb?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active",
    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Setting Contract

In EContracting the contract is created directly in contracting system.

Note

Some of data will be mirrored to tender until contract will be activated for backward compatibility.

Read more about working with EContracting in contracting system in Tutorial section.

Cancelling tender

Tender creator can cancel tender anytime (except when tender in status active.auction or in terminal status e.g. unsuccessful, canceled, complete).

The following steps should be applied:

Prepare cancellation request.

Fill it with the protocol describing the cancellation reasons.

Passing complaint period(10 days)

Cancel the tender with the prepared reasons.

Only the request that has been activated (4th step above) has power to cancel tender. I.e. you have to not only prepare cancellation request but to activate it as well.

For cancelled cancellation you need to update cancellation status to unsuccessful from draft or pending.

See Cancellation data structure for details.

Preparing the cancellation request

You should pass reason and reasonType, status defaults to draft.

There are four possible types of cancellation reason - tender was noDemand, unFixable, forceMajeure and expensesCut.

id is autogenerated and passed in the Location header of response.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/cancellations?acc_token=e81ca7deac284bc5bbfb6eaacbdd43af HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "reasonType": "noDemand"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/32d3b5becccb479ea62a23dc50237f60/cancellations/59f6e84b5edf4f48a99016c2e6b83c1b

{
  "data": {
    "reasonType": "noDemand",
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "id": "59f6e84b5edf4f48a99016c2e6b83c1b",
    "date": "2027-01-01T00:03:00+02:00",
    "cancellationOf": "tender",
    "status": "draft"
  }
}

When cancellation in pending status the tender owner is prohibited from all actions on the tender.

Activating the request and cancelling tender

if the complaint period(duration 10 days) is over and there were no complaints or all complaints are canceled, then cancellation will automatically update status to active.

<!-- PAGE: tendering/openua/overview.md | SOURCE: https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tendering/openua/overview.html -->

The Open Procurement Open UA procedure is plugin to Open Procurement API software. It requires 0.12 version of [openprocurement.api package](https://github.com/ProzorroUKR/openprocurement.api) to work.

REST-ful interface to plugin is in line with core software design principles.

## Main responsibilities

Open Procurement Open UA procedure is dedicated to Open Tender procedure for Ukrainian above threshold procurements. The code for that type of procedure is aboveThresholdUA.

## Business logic

The approach to Open UA procedure is different from core Open Procurement API procedure (that is used for below threshold procurements) mainly in [stage that precedes](https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tendering/openua/tendering.html#openua-tendering) auction. Differences are in the following aspects:

1.   Tender can be edited through the whole tenderPeriod (while in active.tendering state), but any edit that is close to tenderPeriod.endDate would require extending that period.

2.   There is no dedicated active.enguiries state.

3.   Questions can be asked within enquiryPeriod that is based upon tenderPeriod.

4.   Answers are provided during the whole tenderPeriod.

5.   Bids can be placed during the whole tenderPeriod.

6.   Placed bids are invalidated after any tender condition editing and have to be re-confirmed.

## Project status

The project is in active development and has pilot installations.

The source repository for this project is on GitHub: [https://github.com/ProzorroUKR/openprocurement.tender.openua](https://github.com/ProzorroUKR/openprocurement.tender.openua)

You can leave feedback by raising a new issue on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/ProzorroUKR/openprocurement.tender.openua/issues) (GitHub registration necessary).

We can see the same response we got after creating tender.

Let’s see what listing of tenders reveals us:

GET /api/2.5/tenders?opt_pretty=1 HTTP/1.0
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "data": [],
  "next_page": {
    "offset": "",
    "path": "/api/2.5/tenders",
    "uri": "http://public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders"
  }
}

We don’t see internal id of tender, because tender appears in the listing from active.tendering status.

Tender can contain several different lots. We can add lot using the following way:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/lots?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

Before activating tender it is required to add sign document to tender. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: notice and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/documents?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "title": "sign.p7s",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/b43465c8868348f6a09900f433c96294?Signature=qplLMg5L3fIxX2RTMI%2FN3WuKntX%2F%2FkWhzDwgndmZOS8LswbqUgLHcNuQfpelvQYRKBqnIQ%2BV0h%2FwQPgXho2PBA%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "format": "application/pkcs7-signature"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/documents/bddd09e655f84e15aa516015b70a9e13

Expand
{
  "data": {
    "confidentiality": "public",
    "documentType": "notice",
    "hash": "md5:00000000000000000000000000000000",
    "title": "sign.p7s",

    "url": "http://public-docs-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/get/b43465c8868348f6a09900f433c96294?Signature=x2Oh7KvlHiUmjCNdfhaEvCy6Z8K4HfZDOYVoZjQVsc0IiqognuUIr3nBrTQTa4lxuNUeNGV7rZUYfv32nQaTBQ%3D%3D&KeyID=a8968c46",

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.tendering"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK

Procuring entity can not change tender if there are less than 7 days before tenderPeriod ends. Changes will not be accepted by API.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "value": {
      "amount": 501.0
    }
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "data",
      "description": "tenderPeriod should be extended by 7 days"
    }
  ]
}

That is why tenderPeriod has to be extended by 7 days.

Authorization: Bearer broker

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Then bidder should approve bid with pending status. If tenderers.identifier.scheme = ‘UA-EDR’ it is required to add sign document to bid. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/bids/f4f4958a25d641dc903708cc957eab58?acc_token=60f4f451f2864f7e9428372a1316e992 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'proposal' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

If we try to activate bidder the new sign will be needed:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/bids/f4f4958a25d641dc903708cc957eab58?acc_token=60f4f451f2864f7e9428372a1316e992 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'proposal' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Bid invalidation

If tender is modified, status of all bid proposals will be changed to invalid. Bid proposal will look the following way after tender has been modified:

GET /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/bids/f4f4958a25d641dc903708cc957eab58?acc_token=60f4f451f2864f7e9428372a1316e992 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

  ]

Confirming qualification

Qualification comission can set award to active or unsuccessful status.

There are validations before registering qualification decision:

eligible: True and qualified: True - for setting award from pending to active

eligible: False and qualified: True OR eligible: True and qualified: False OR eligible: False and qualified: False - for setting award from pending to unsuccessful

Let’s try to set unsuccessful status for qualified and eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/awards/1dd5e04991ed40a59339830475a8250d?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "unsuccessful",
    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Let’s try to set active status for non-qualified or non-eligible award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/awards/1dd5e04991ed40a59339830475a8250d?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active",
    "qualified": false,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to active status with not qualified"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Before making decision it is required to add sign document to award. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/awards/1dd5e04991ed40a59339830475a8250d?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active",
    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

The same logic for unsuccessful status:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/awards/1dd5e04991ed40a59339830475a8250d?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker

Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "unsuccessful"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

    "qualified": true,
    "eligible": true,
    "complaintPeriod": {
      "startDate": "2027-01-01T00:02:01+02:00",
      "endDate": "2027-01-12T00:00:00+02:00"
    }
  }
}

Setting Contract

In EContracting the contract is created directly in contracting system.

Note

Some of data will be mirrored to tender until contract will be activated for backward compatibility.

Read more about working with EContracting in contracting system in Tutorial section.

Cancelling tender

Tender creator can cancel tender anytime (except when tender in status active.auction or in terminal status e.g. unsuccessful, canceled, complete).

The following steps should be applied:

Prepare cancellation request.

Fill it with the protocol describing the cancellation reasons.

Passing complaint period(10 days)

Cancel the tender with the prepared reasons.

Only the request that has been activated (4th step above) has power to cancel tender. I.e. you have to not only prepare cancellation request but to activate it as well.

For cancelled cancellation you need to update cancellation status to unsuccessful from draft or pending.

See Cancellation data structure for details.

Preparing the cancellation request

You should pass reason and reasonType, status defaults to draft.

There are four possible types of cancellation reason - tender was noDemand, unFixable, forceMajeure and expensesCut.

id is autogenerated and passed in the Location header of response.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/cancellations?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "reasonType": "unFixable"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/cancellations/cf322d6f287a48c9aee34f0552fb2414

{
  "data": {
    "reasonType": "unFixable",
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "id": "cf322d6f287a48c9aee34f0552fb2414",
    "date": "2027-01-01T00:02:01+02:00",
    "cancellationOf": "tender",
    "status": "draft"
  }
}

You can change reasonType value to any of the above.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/cancellations/cf322d6f287a48c9aee34f0552fb2414?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0

  }

Passing Complaint Period

For activate complaint period, you need to update cancellation from draft to pending.

Before activating cancellation request, you must add a signature file to cancellation. If there is no signature file when activating the cancellation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/afbae9188b434d3bb77426b13e9a5165/cancellations/cf322d6f287a48c9aee34f0552fb2414?acc_token=b67eb5061d5445afa4ea2a1bffb1ee5a HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "pending"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "documents",
      "description": "Document with type 'cancellationReport' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
    }
  ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: cancellationReport and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

When cancellation in pending status the tender owner is prohibited from all actions on the tender.

Activating the request and cancelling tender

if the complaint period(duration 10 days) is over and there were no complaints or all complaints are canceled, then cancellation will automatically update status to active.

Success! Now we can see that new object was created. Response code is 201 and Location response header reports the location of the created object. The body of response reveals the information about the created tender: its internal id (that matches the Location segment), its official tenderID and dateModified datestamp stating the moment in time when tender was last modified. Note that tender is created with draft status.

Note

User receives access: token with which operations as a Procuring Entity role are accessible.

Price Quotation procedure has `procurementMethodType`: `priceQuotation` and `procurementMethod`: `selective`.

## Publishing tender (deprecated)

After creation Procuring Entity publishes procedure by changing status to draft.publishing where **priceQuotationBot** robot runs validation of the procedure and supplement procedure with additional data taken from ProZorro e-Catalogues database including shortListedFirms.

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

## Activating tender

After creation Procuring Entity can activate tender by changing status to active.tendering.

Before activating tender it is required to add sign document to tender.

Note

When conducting a PQ procurement by an organization that is not a Customer within the meaning of the law (kind:other), adding sign document during activating tender is not required.

If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "status": "active.tendering"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "documents",
 "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
 }
 ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: notice and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/documents?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {

 }

During activation CBD runs some validations:

*   Existence of item profile in catalogue

*   Profile should be active or general

*   Existence of related agreement

*   Equality of profile agreement and related agreement in tender

*   Agreement should not be in terminated status

If Procuring Entity will try to activate PQ procedure with non-existed profile in catalogue, we will see error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "status": "active.tendering"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 404 Not Found
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "Profiles 655360-30230000-889652-40000777 not found in catalouges."
 }
 ]
}

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json

 "status": "active.tendering"
 }
}

 "location": "body",

 }
 ]
}

 "description": "Tender agreement doesn't match profile agreement"
 }

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0

 "location": "body",
 "name": "agreement",
 "description": "Agreement status is not active"
 }
 ]
}

## Bid submission

### Registering bid

Tender status `active.tendering` allows registration of bids.

If bid tenderer is not a member of agreement, than we will see an error during registration of bid:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/bids HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "Bid is not a member of agreement"
 }
 ]
}

Note

For PQ bids have strict validation: the amount of bids by item (item.quantity * item.unit.value.amount) must be greater than 0, and may differ downwards from bid.value.amount by no more than 20%.

If sum of unit items values are less than net value bid.value.amount (bid.value.amount * 1.2), the bidder will see the error:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/bids HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

## Active tendering period end

After tender period ended, CBD checks one more time status of contract for suppliers in agreement. If contract status is still active - bid is getting active status too, in other cases - bid gets invalid status.

Let’s imagine that second contract supplier in agreement was disqualified during active.tendering period.

Let’s see our bids statuses after active.tendering period ends. Last bid was disqualified:

GET /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/bids?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

## Awarding process

After the tender period end date, system automatically creates award in pending status for the bid with the most economically advantageous price.

Qualification comission can set award to active or unsuccessful status.

There are validations before registering qualification decision:

*   qualified: True - for setting award from pending to active

*   qualified: False - for setting award from pending to unsuccessful

Let’s try to set unsuccessful status for qualified award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/awards/b1c41ec4a4d84cdb82270c0795928bfd?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "status": "unsuccessful",
 "qualified": true
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "qualified",
 "description": [
 "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
 ]
 }
 ]
}

Before activating the winner it is required to add sign document to award. If there is no sign document during activation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/awards/b1c41ec4a4d84cdb82270c0795928bfd?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0

Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

 "status": "active",
 "qualified": true
 }
}

Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "documents",
 "description": "Document with type 'notice' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
 }
 ]
}

Note

If the offer of the Participant with the lowest price meets the requirements, Procuring Entity uploads a document that recognizes the offer as the Winner (awards:status:active). If it does not meet the requirements, Procuring Entity downloads a protocol confirming its decision to reject the Participant and rejects such an offer (awards:status:unsuccessful). The system leads to the evaluation of the next one with most economically advantageous price (awards:status:pending).

Before declining the award it is required to add sign document to award. If there is no sign document during declining, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/awards/a6c7b280a49c4f7788e5768c3ce3464b?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "status": "unsuccessful"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "qualified",
 "description": [
 "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
 ]
 }
 ]
}

## Setting Contract

In EContracting the contract is created directly in contracting system.

Note

Some of data will be mirrored to tender until contract will be activated for backward compatibility.

Read more about working with EContracting in contracting system in [Tutorial](https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contracting/contract/tutorial.html#contracting-tutorial) section.

## Cancelling tender

Tender creator can cancel tender anytime (except when tender in terminal status e.g. draft.unsuccessful, unsuccessful, cancelled, complete).

The following steps should be applied:

1.   Prepare cancellation request.

2.   Fill it with the protocol describing the cancellation reasons.

3.   Cancel the tender with the prepared reasons.

Only the request that has been activated (3rd step above) has power to cancel tender. I.e. you have to not only prepare cancellation request but to activate it as well.

For cancelled cancellation you need to update cancellation status to unsuccessful from draft or pending.

See [Cancellation](https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/standard/cancellation.html#cancellation) data structure for details.

### Preparing the cancellation request

You should pass reason and reasonType, status defaults to draft.

There are four possible types of cancellation reason - tender was noDemand, unFixable, forceMajeure and expensesCut.

id is autogenerated and passed in the Location header of response.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/cancellations?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "reason": "cancellation reason",
 "reasonType": "noDemand"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/cancellations/ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "reasonType": "noDemand",
 "reason": "cancellation reason",
 "id": "ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f",
 "date": "2024-01-01T00:00:01+02:00",
 "cancellationOf": "tender",
 "status": "draft"
 }
}

You can change `reasonType` value to any of the above.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/cancellations/ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "reasonType": "expensesCut"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "id": "ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f",
 "status": "draft",
 "date": "2024-01-01T00:00:01+02:00",
 "reasonType": "expensesCut",
 "reason": "cancellation reason",
 "cancellationOf": "tender"
 }
}

### Activating the request and cancelling tender

Before activating cancellation request, you must add a signature file to cancellation.

Note

When conducting a PQ procurement by an organization that is not a Customer within the meaning of the law (kind:other), adding sign document during activating cancellation request is not required.

If there is no signature file when activating the cancellation, we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/cancellations/ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

Expand

{
 "data": {
 "status": "active"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "documents",
 "description": "Document with type 'cancellationReport' and format pkcs7-signature is required"
 }
 ]
}

Sign document should have documentType: cancellationReport and title: *.p7s. Let’s add such document:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/2874d5c2acd649bbb8679e9439621113/cancellations/ad5fdab416c8405789f80308b835a91f/documents?acc_token=3f07ab10456e4f519a3cf51c24d19c80 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker

Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

## Creating tender with inspector

To create tender with inspector you should set field inspector on creation (or you can in set it later by patching tender in draft or active.enquiries statuses)

Inspector field can be set only together with funders .

that’s what will happen if you try to create tender with inspector without funders:

## Create review request

Review request can create tender owner for tender with inspector and only in active.enquiries, active.qualification (if procedure with multiple lots)/ active.awarded (if procedure with one or without lots).

POST /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {}
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests/0b98081079674cf1834f21d5e0e3d3ac

{
 "data": {
 "id": "0b98081079674cf1834f21d5e0e3d3ac",
 "dateCreated": "2027-01-01T00:00:00+02:00",
 "tenderStatus": "active.enquiries"
 }
}

Depends on status from the moment of creation to the moment of providing the result prohibited:
*   active.enquiries - PATCH tender(except tenderPeriod)

*   active.qualification/active.awarded - PATCH awards, activate contracts

Let’s try to patch tender description:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "description": "Оновлений опис"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "With unanswered review request can be patched only ('tenderPeriod',) fields"
 }
 ]
}

Now let’s patch tenderPeriod:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "tenderPeriod": {
 "startDate": "2027-01-11T00:00:00+02:00",
 "endDate": "2027-01-19T00:00:00+02:00"
 }
 }
}

New review request can’t be created if already exists unanswered review request:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {}
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "Disallowed create review request while existing another unanswered review request"
 }
 ]
}

### Create review request on qualification stage

If procedure has lots, review request should be created with lotID:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {}
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "lotID",
 "description": "Required field."
 }
 ]
}

Review request on qualification stage(active.qualification/active.awarded) can be created only if exists active award.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests?acc_token=dae7afe6e0d149468a4426e0384ca817 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "lotID": "a22bd0578dd3446fa1717fee9d688b77"
 }
}

Content-Type: application/json

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "Review request can be created only for lot with active award"
 }
 ]
}

## Inspector providing review result

Provide result on review request can only user with inspector role using PATCH method:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests/0b98081079674cf1834f21d5e0e3d3ac HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer inspector
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "approved": false,
 "description": "Виправте description"
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "data": {
 "id": "0b98081079674cf1834f21d5e0e3d3ac",
 "tenderStatus": "active.enquiries",
 "approved": false,
 "description": "Виправте description",
 "dateCreated": "2027-01-01T00:00:00+02:00",
 "date": "2027-01-01T00:00:00+02:00"
 }
}

Inspector can’t provide review result on the same review request twice:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests/0b98081079674cf1834f21d5e0e3d3ac HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer inspector
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "approved": true
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "status": "error",
 "errors": [
 {
 "location": "body",
 "name": "data",
 "description": "Disallowed re-patching review request"
 }
 ]
}

The procedure cannot go further through the statuses until the controller gives a positive response to review request.

So buyer should make changes, create new review request and after that inspector can provide new result:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/20570f0f6c354a03b0ff0062f3cd1524/review_requests/67c79432a5f1456fbe492842a2e8584c HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer inspector
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
 "data": {
 "approved": true
 }
}

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
 "data": {
 "id": "67c79432a5f1456fbe492842a2e8584c",
 "tenderStatus": "active.enquiries",
 "approved": true,
 "dateCreated": "2027-01-01T00:00:00+02:00",
 "date": "2027-01-01T00:00:00+02:00",
 "is_valid": true
 }
}

<!-- PAGE: tendering/requestforproposal/multicurrency.md | SOURCE: https://prozorro-api-docs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/tendering/requestforproposal/multicurrency.html -->

Multi currency

The requestForProposal procedure can be multi currency for donors. To create such type of procedure it is required to set config valueCurrencyEquality:false and add funders field.

In this way, it will be possible to add a price list of items to the procedure in different currency. The price list will help to visually show which parts make up the total price of the participant for each item separately.

Let’s create tender with configuration valueCurrencyEquality:false and funders field, add lots for it and activate it:

GET /api/2.5/tenders/73862f0482bd4d22a4bf40cd491a2b20 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

The requirements for bid registration:

The currency value for each unit price must match the currency value of the total bid price

The total cost of Lot-level Unit Prices may NOT equal the total bid price

The VAT value in the unit price must be False

If the participant plans to give the customer a so-called discount, he can specify the value 0 for certain items in the Price per unit value

Let’s try to change VAT value in bid.items.unit to different than False and we will see the error:

The total offer price and the price per unit are adjusted both upwards and downwards.

At the same time, the total cost of the price per unit can be not equal to the total price of the offer.

VAT can be changed at the contract level (must be changed in both contract.value and contract.items.unit.value at the same time).

Let’s patch contract values:

Content-Type: application/json

Creating tender

Tender requestForProposal may have pre-selection procedure and can be connected to agreement.

Let’s use next agreement for our example:

GET /api/2.5/agreements/144de8e79e64488a967c57cebaacb0d3 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

We can see the same response we got after creating tender.

Let’s see what listing of tenders reveals us:

GET /api/2.5/tenders HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Host: public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "data": [],
  "next_page": {
    "offset": "",
    "path": "/api/2.5/tenders",
    "uri": "http://public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders"
  }
}

We don’t see internal id of tender, because tender appears in the listing from active.enquiries status.

Tender can contain several different lots. We can add lot using the following way:

POST /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/lots?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active.enquiries"

Procuring entity can not change tenderPeriod.endDate if there are less than 4 days before tenderPeriod ends. Changes will not be accepted by API.

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "value": {
      "amount": 501.0
    },
    "tenderPeriod": {
      "endDate": "2027-01-09T00:10:05+02:00"
    }
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "data",
      "description": "tenderPeriod should be extended by 4 days"
    }
  ]
}

That is why tenderPeriod has to be extended by minimum 4 days.

Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

In the response you should see one version of the Notice document and two versions of the AwardCriteria document. Both versions have the same id field, but datePublished fields are different. Because that’s the time when files were published.

Notice, the datePublished and dateModified fields are the same. That’s because their documents details haven’t been additionally changed.

Also notice, the fields that can be additionally modified like title, language, description etc. All of them are applied to the latest version. The previous version keeps its own values.

Registering bid

Confirming qualification

Qualification comission can set award to active or unsuccessful status.

There are validations before registering qualification decision:

qualified: True - for setting award from pending to active

qualified: False - for setting award from pending to unsuccessful

Let’s try to set unsuccessful status for qualified award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/awards/d7753a57912a4547ac35509b690cd6d3?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "unsuccessful",
    "qualified": true
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to unsuccessful status when qualified/eligible isn't set to False"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Let’s try to set active status for non-qualified award and we will see an error:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/awards/d7753a57912a4547ac35509b690cd6d3?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "status": "active",
    "qualified": false
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

Expand
{
  "status": "error",
  "errors": [
    {
      "location": "body",
      "name": "qualified",
      "description": [
        "Can't update award to active status with not qualified"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

Qualification commission registers its decision via the following call:

PATCH /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/awards/d7753a57912a4547ac35509b690cd6d3?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{

Setting Contract

In EContracting the contract is created directly in contracting system.

Note

Some of data will be mirrored to tender until contract will be activated for backward compatibility.

Read more about working with EContracting in contracting system in Tutorial section.

Cancelling tender

Tender creator can cancel tender anytime (except when tender has terminal status e.g. unsuccessful, canceled, complete).

The following steps should be applied:

Prepare cancellation request

Fill it with the protocol describing the cancellation reasons

Cancel the tender with the reasons prepared.

Only the request that has been activated (3rd step above) has power to cancel tender. I.e. you have to not only prepare cancellation request but to activate it as well.

See Cancellation data structure for details.

Preparing the cancellation request

You should pass reason and reasonType, status defaults to draft.

id is autogenerated and passed in the Location header of response.

POST /api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/cancellations?acc_token=76e7037e0a9a445f8bfe44a967308c41 HTTP/1.0
Authorization: Bearer broker
Content-Type: application/json
Host: lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua

{
  "data": {
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "reasonType": "noDemand"
  }
}

HTTP/1.0 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: http://lb-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/513a5729b98b4078a5e0c1ffb39e3c9a/cancellations/877dff2f25f14e2b953a129d3c5ff8d2

{
  "data": {
    "reasonType": "noDemand",
    "reason": "cancellation reason",
    "id": "877dff2f25f14e2b953a129d3c5ff8d2",
    "date": "2027-01-07T00:15:06+02:00",
    "cancellationOf": "tender",
    "status": "draft"
  }
}

## Feed violation report updates

Violation reports appear in their feed when the get public changes.

These are:
1.   violationReport is published

2.   defendantStatement is published

3.   decision is published

GET /violation_reports HTTP/1.0

HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8
X-Request-ID: 88888888-4444-5555-6666-000000000032
Content-Length: 385

{
 "data": [
 {
 "dateModified": "2025-10-16T10:16:08+03:00",
 "id": "88888888444455556666000000000006"
 }
 ],
 "next_page": {
 "offset": "1760598968.0.1.402322bdc529b2a2ba4ee53ba1042c99",
 "path": "/violation_reports?offset=1760598968.0.1.402322bdc529b2a2ba4ee53ba1042c99",
 "uri": "http://public-api-sandbox.prozorro.gov.ua/violation_reports?offset=1760598968.0.1.402322bdc529b2a2ba4ee53ba1042c99"
 }
}
